CustomField.description: Adds a Clone action that duplicates a row on Repeater and Table sections. Button text comes from Clone Action Button Label, and on Tables the clone window uses the Table Clone Action Modal Title and Subtitle. Not offered once the section reaches its Max rows.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to let users duplicate a row in this repeater or table. Set the button label with Clone Action Button Label; cloning is blocked once the Max row limit is reached.
CustomField.label: Enable Clone Action
